common.tamper.finding.seal_not_as_writte: a seal on the door is not the one written
common.tamper.finding.seal_not_as_on_the: the seals are not as the note says
common.tamper.finding.wrap_cut: the wrap or packaging is cut or opened
common.tamper.finding.inspection_failed: the 7-point inspection found something — a false wall, floor or roof, a hidden space, or signs of tampering
common.tamper.heldTitle: Held: SeeBuyGet operations has been told
common.tamper.heldWait: Keep it closed and where it is. It changes hands with nobody until operations releases it.
common.tamper.releaseTooShort: Say what was found and what was done: at least {n} characters.
common.bag.closeTitle: Close the bag for the road
common.bag.sealLabel: The number printed on the seal
common.bag.sealHint: Pull the seal tight through the bag’s zip, then type its number as printed on it.
common.bag.photoSeal: Photograph the bag closed, the seal and its number in view
common.bag.photoOnlyHint: Without a seal, whoever receives it can only compare the bag with your photograph. A coded seal shows if it was opened.
common.bag.readSeal: The number on its seal, as printed
common.bag.readSealHint: Read it off the seal itself: it is not shown here, so your reading is what counts.
common.bag.unsealed: It was closed without a seal: look at it closely, and photograph it as it arrived.
common.bag.photoArrived: Photograph the bag as it arrived, its seal in view
common.bag.notAsClosed: Cut, opened or the seal broken
common.bag.notAsClosedBody: Report it with a photograph: the bag is held and SeeBuyGet operations told. It is received once operations releases it.
common.bag.mismatchTitle: Not the number it was closed with
common.bag.mismatchBody: Read it again, slowly. Still not the same? Report it — do not open the bag.
common.bag.mismatchReport: Still not the same? Report it
common.bag.reportTitle: A bag not as it was closed
common.bag.reportBody: What you report holds bag {code}: nobody opens it, receives it or loads it until SeeBuyGet operations has looked. Photograph it before anything is touched.
common.bag.reportWho: SeeBuyGet operations is told at once. Kept with the bag’s record and its parcels’ SSCCs, with your photograph.
common.bag.finding.seal_not_as_written: The seal is not the one it was closed with
common.bag.finding.wrap_cut: The bag is cut or opened
common.bag.heldNote: Held: SeeBuyGet operations has been told. Keep it closed until they release it.
common.bag.photoTaken: Photograph the bag as you take it, its seal in view
common.bag.notAsClosedTakeTitle: Report it before you go on
common.bag.notAsClosedTakeBody: Report it with a photograph: the bag is held where it is and SeeBuyGet operations told. Keep it closed; it goes on once operations releases it.
common.instructions.title: Instructions from the sender
common.found.short: {n, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} short
common.found.over: {n, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} more than the note says
common.found.damaged: {n, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} damaged
common.found.wrong: {n, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} not the goods on the note
common.found.refused: {n, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} refused
account.password.title: Change your password
account.password.note: Every other device still signed in with the old password is signed out. This one stays signed in.
account.password.done: Password changed. Any other device that was signed in has been signed out.
account.password.tooShort: A new password needs at least 8 characters.
account.password.tooShort10: A new password needs at least 10 characters.
account.password.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
account.password.same: Choose a password different from the current one.
account.menu.photoSet: Tap to change it or your name
account.menu.photoNone: Add one so people know who turned up
account.menu.name: Your name
account.menu.nameHint: Shown to the people you collect from and deliver to. Not your legal name — that stays where you gave it.
account.menu.photoHint: Any photo: this phone makes it smaller before it is sent.
upload.tooBig.photo: This photo is still {size} after making it smaller; the most is {limit}. Take it again, a little further away.
upload.tooBig.document: This file is {size}; the most is {limit}. Choose a smaller one, or take a photo of the paper instead.
upload.tooBig.voice: This recording is {size}; the most is {limit}. Record a shorter message.
upload.tooBig.sheet: This file is {size}; the most is {limit}. Send only the sheet with the rows on it, or copy the rows and paste them instead.
upload.tooBig.at: That file is too large to send; the most is {limit}. Choose a smaller one, or take a photo instead.
upload.tooBig.any: That file is too large to send. Choose a smaller one, or take a photo instead.
upload.wrongType.photo: That is not a photo. Choose a photo, or take one with the camera.
upload.wrongType.document: That kind of file cannot be sent here. Choose a PDF, or a photo of the paper.
upload.wrongType.voice: This phone records sound in a kind of file that cannot be sent. Type the message instead.
upload.wrongType.sheet: That is not a spreadsheet. Choose a spreadsheet file, or copy the rows and paste them.
upload.unreadable: This phone could not open that picture. Choose another, or take a photo with the camera.
upload.unreadableLarge: This phone could not open that picture: at {size} it is too large for it. Take a photo with the camera instead, or choose a smaller one.
upload.empty: That file is empty. Choose another.
upload.notRead: This phone could not read that file. Choose it again.
upload.failed: It did not go. Try again.
upload.hint.photo: Any photo: it is made smaller before it is sent.
upload.hint.document: A PDF or a photo, up to {limit}. A photo is made smaller before it is sent, if it needs to be.
upload.hint.evidence: A screenshot or a photo: it is made smaller before it is sent.
upload.hint.boundary: A GeoJSON file of areas, up to {limit}.
photo.failed: The photo did not go — tap to try again
photo.chooseFile: Or choose a photo or PDF from the phone
photo.paperSaved: Paper saved — tap to take a photo instead
account.menu.addressBody: Kept for paperwork and payments, and never shown to anyone you deliver to. You can remove it whenever you like.
account.safety.codeSentEarlier: We sent a code to this address at {time}. Type it here: it works for 15 minutes, and asking again sends the same one.
account.address.before: Your address now reads: {address}. Put it into its parts below.
account.menu.pinSub: The 5 digits you sign in with
account.menu.pinBody: Changing it signs you out everywhere, on this phone too — so you will sign back in with the new one. That is what stops a PIN somebody else learned from outliving the change.
account.menu.passwordSub: The password you sign in with
install.bar.title: Install the {app} app
install.bar.sub: It opens from your home screen, and tells you when something needs you
install.sheet.title: Get the most out of the {app} app
install.sheet.lede: A few taps, once. Then it opens from your home screen like any app, full screen, and tells you the moment something needs you.
install.sheet.ledeInstalled: It is on your home screen. Make sure it can tell you the moment something needs you.
install.platform.label: Your phone
install.step.home.title: Put it on your home screen
install.step.home.androidPrompt: Tap Install now, below, then Install.
install.step.home.android: In Chrome, tap ⋮ at the top right, then Install app. Some phones say Add to Home screen.
install.step.home.ios: In Safari, tap Share at the bottom of the screen, then Add to Home Screen, then Add.
install.step.allow.title: Allow its notifications
install.step.allow.text: Open the app from its icon on your home screen. When it asks to send you notifications, tap Allow.
install.step.allow.ios: Open the app from its icon on your home screen, not from Safari. When it asks to send you notifications, tap Allow. An iPhone needs iOS 16.4 or later for this.
install.step.fix.title: Said no, or nothing arrives?
install.step.fix.hold: Hold the app’s icon on your home screen for two seconds, then tap ⓘ, App info.
install.step.fix.on: Turn notifications on, all of them.
install.step.fix.ios: Open Settings, then Notifications, then {app}, and turn on Allow Notifications.
install.step.battery.title: Notifications late?
install.step.battery.text: Many phones hold apps back to save battery. In App info, tap Battery, then Unrestricted. Some phones say No restrictions, or Allow background activity.
install.done: It is on my home screen
install.result.dismissed: Not installed. You can install it any time from here.
install.result.unavailable: This browser cannot install it from here. Use its menu, as above.
install.menu: Get the most out of the app
account.pair.show: No code? Link it with a phone the {party} already uses
account.pair.title: Link this phone with a phone the {party} uses
account.pair.qrLabel: The code for a phone of the {party} to scan
account.pair.codeLabel: The code, to type in instead of scanning
account.pair.how: On a phone the {party} already uses: your picture → Settings → the phones → “Link a new phone”. Scan this code there, or type it in.
account.pair.waiting: It works for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. This phone signs in as soon as it is scanned.
account.pair.ranOut: The code ran out before a phone of the account scanned it
account.pair.noPhone: No phone of the {party} is signed in to scan a code
account.pair.noPhoneSub: Use the code sent to the {party}’s number. If none can come, Help → “Trouble signing in?” says who helps.
account.pair.onlyLede: Codes cannot be texted to the {party}’s number from here yet. Link this phone with a phone the {party} already uses: it scans the code below.
account.pair.linkLede: On the new phone, sign in with the {party}’s email and password, then tap “Link it with a phone the {party} already uses”. It shows a code: scan it here, or type it in.
account.pair.scanTitle: Scan the code on the new phone
account.pair.typeLabel: Or type the code on the new phone
account.pair.linked: Linked: the new phone is signed in to the {party}
account.apps.title: Your SeeBuyGet apps
account.apps.sub: Signed in with this email, on this phone
account.apps.waiting.pudo: Your shop waits for “Yes, it is me”
account.apps.waiting.mdp: Your hub waits for “Yes, it is me”
account.apps.waiting.vendor: Your store waits for “Yes, it is me”
account.apps.waitingSub: Tap it in the email “Is this you?” we sent to this address. Then it opens from here.
account.share.title: Share SeeBuyGet
account.share.sub: Send your own link to the people you work with
account.share.lede: Your own link to SeeBuyGet. It opens as a card with a picture and a line about us, and whoever signs up through it is counted to you.
account.share.text: Join me on SeeBuyGet — sending, carrying and collecting, near you:
account.share.textNamed: Join {name} on SeeBuyGet — sending, carrying and collecting, near you:
account.share.copied: Copied — paste it in a chat.
account.share.failed: That did not open here. Copy the link instead.
account.share.joined: {n, plural, one {# person joined through your link} other {# people joined through your link}}
account.pin.guessable: That PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid mostly one digit, a run like 12345 or 13579, and a pattern like 12312.
account.choosePin.title: Choose a PIN
account.choosePin.lede: We send a code to your phone. You type it, then choose a PIN. The first time, you also add a recovery email.
account.choosePin.pinLede: Pick 5 digits you will remember. Not the PIN of your mobile money or your bank card.
account.choosePin.done: It works on this phone or browser from now on. Sign in with your number and this PIN.
account.device.title: Confirm this phone or browser
account.device.lede: Your PIN does not work on this phone or browser yet. We sent a 6-digit code to {phone}. Type it once, and your PIN works here from now on.
account.device.ledeUnsent: Your PIN does not work on this phone or browser yet. A 6-digit code to {phone} confirms it. Type it once, and your PIN works here from now on.
account.device.sandbox: Sandbox: no message is sent here, so this is your code: {code}
account.device.why: Your PIN opens your account only on a phone or browser that has shown it holds your number. Nobody can try your PIN from anywhere else. One that is not used for 90 days, or that you chose to forget in Settings, is asked for a code again.
account.pin.mismatch: The two new PINs are not the same.
account.pin.same: Choose a PIN different from the current one.
account.age.days: Last changed {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago
account.age.due: over 90 days — a good moment to change it
account.settings.title: Settings
account.mute.title: Mute my account
account.mute.sub: Rest it: nothing new reaches it until you unmute
account.mute.mutedSince: Since {when}. Nothing new reaches it until you unmute it, below.
account.mute.lede: Muting rests your account. Nothing is deleted, and you can unmute it here at any time.
account.mute.what1: Your phone is not rung and no emails are sent, except sign-in codes and what keeps your account safe. Notifications still go to the list in the app, for when you look.
account.mute.what2: Nobody can start new work with you: a shop of yours is not offered for new parcels and leaves the map, you are offered no loads as a driver, your fleet takes no new work, and your store takes no new orders.
account.mute.what3: What you already hold goes on: parcels on your shelf, loads you are carrying, orders already shipped. A sort hub keeps sorting what the network sends it.
account.mute.what4: You can still sign in and read everything.
account.mute.unmuteBody: Unmuting offers everything to you again from that moment. Nothing you missed while it rested is sent again.
account.close.title: Close my account
account.close.sub: Not used for four years: you can close it
account.close.lede: Closing removes your name, ID number, phone number, email and ID photos, and signs you out everywhere. Parcels, hand-overs and consignment notes stay, showing “closed account” where you were: they are other people’s records too. It cannot be undone.
account.close.reading: Checking whether anything is still open…
account.close.openTitle: Not yet: something is still open
account.close.openLede: When these are finished, you can close your account here.
account.close.open.parcels: {n, plural, one {# parcel you sent or are to collect is still on its way.} other {# parcels you sent or are to collect are still on their way.}}
account.close.open.shop-parcels: {n, plural, one {# parcel is still at, or on its way to or from, your shop.} other {# parcels are still at, or on their way to or from, your shop.}}
account.close.open.shop-money: Your shop still holds money with SeeBuyGet, or owes some.
account.close.open.loads: {n, plural, one {# load is still aboard with you.} other {# loads are still aboard with you.}}
account.close.open.driver-money: You are still owed for loads you carried.
account.close.open.fleet-drivers: {n, plural, one {# driver still drives for your fleet.} other {# drivers still drive for your fleet.}}
account.close.open.fleet-loads: {n, plural, one {# load is still being carried by your fleet.} other {# loads are still being carried by your fleet.}}
account.close.open.hub: You run a sort hub. SeeBuyGet staff take it off the network first: write to us from the help, under “My data, or closing my account”.
account.close.open.store-parcels: {n, plural, one {# parcel from your store is still on its way.} other {# parcels from your store are still on their way.}}
account.close.open.store-orders: {n, plural, one {# order at your store is not shipped yet.} other {# orders at your store are not shipped yet.}}
account.close.open.store-money: Your store still holds money with SeeBuyGet.
account.close.open.claims: {n, plural, one {# claim on a load is still open.} other {# claims on loads are still open.}}
account.close.open.id-dispute: A dispute over the national ID on your registration is still open.
account.close.open.account-move: Somebody has asked to move this account to another number. Settle that first, at the top of Settings.
account.close.doneBody: Your personal details have been removed, and you have been signed out everywhere.
account.settings.lede: How you sign in, and how you get back in if something goes wrong.
account.settings.pinStays: Every other phone signed in with the old PIN is signed out. This one stays signed in.
account.settings.emailNone: Not set — add one so you can always get back in
account.settings.emailBody: We write to this address when your PIN is locked or your phone number changes, and it is the way back into your account if you lose your number and forget your PIN. Nobody else is shown it.
account.settings.moveAsked.title: Somebody asked for your account to be moved
account.settings.moveAsked.detail: On {when}, somebody told SeeBuyGet staff that they had lost this account’s phone number and its PIN, and asked for the account to be moved to a number ending {ends}. Staff check who is asking before anything changes. If that was not you, stop it now.
account.settings.moveAsked.stop: It was not me: stop it
account.settings.moveAsked.stopped: It cannot be approved now. Change your PIN: somebody knows your phone number and tried to take the account.
account.trouble.staff: Ask SeeBuyGet staff to move my account
account.trouble.staffSub: No number, no PIN, and no recovery email you can read
account.trouble.status: I already asked staff: what became of it?
account.trouble.statusSub: With the reference you were given
account.move.lede: Two members of SeeBuyGet staff can move your account to a new phone number, after checking who you are. First confirm that the new number is yours. You are then given a reference: give it to staff when you speak to them. Whoever is on the account is told that this was asked for.
account.move.oldPhone: The number your account is on
account.move.newPhone: The new number to move it to
account.move.nationalId: National ID number, if you registered with one
account.move.nationalIdHint: Drivers and shops registered with one. We check it against the account and do not keep what you type.
account.move.note: What happened? (for the member of staff)
account.move.cta: Ask staff to move my account
account.move.askedDetail: Speak to SeeBuyGet staff and give them this reference. They check who you are before anything changes. It waits until {date}. To see what became of it, come back to “Trouble signing in?” and choose “I already asked staff”.
account.move.noSupport: SeeBuyGet staff in your country. Take your reference, and your ID if you registered with one.
account.move.statusLede: Enter the reference you were given when you asked. It says where your request stands and what to do next.
account.move.state.asked: Waiting for staff to check who you are
account.move.state.askedDetail: Nobody has checked yet. Speak to SeeBuyGet staff and give them your reference. It waits until {date}.
account.move.state.checked: A member of staff has checked who you are
account.move.state.checkedDetail: A second member of staff has to approve it before the account moves. It waits until {date}.
account.move.state.moved: Your account was moved to your new number
account.move.state.movedDetail: Sign in with the new number as if you forgot your PIN: choose the forgot-PIN link under the sign-in, enter the code sent to it, and choose a new PIN. Your parcels are still in your account. To keep them safe, their collection codes were changed and show again 24 hours after the move. For seven days a parcel sent to your old number still reaches you: give the new number to the people and the stores that send to you.
account.move.state.stopped: It was stopped from the account itself
account.move.state.stoppedDetail: Somebody signed in to that account after you asked, or said from inside it that this was not them. If it is your account and you can sign in, move the number yourself: Settings, then Phone number.
account.move.state.lapsedDetail: The request waited two weeks and has lapsed.
account.trouble.id: Somebody else registered with my national ID
account.trouble.idSub: You tried to register as a driver or a shop and were refused
account.id.open.lede: A driver and a shop each register with a national ID number, and nobody else can register with the same one. If yours is already taken, say so here. You will send three photographs of yourself with your ID card, and two members of SeeBuyGet staff decide whose it is.
account.id.open.number: The number on my ID card
account.id.open.numberHint: Exactly as it is on the card. Check it first: one wrong digit is the usual reason.
account.id.open.phoneHint: We send it a code. If the ID is decided to be yours, it is kept for whoever registers with this number.
account.id.step.write: Write your reference on a piece of paper, large enough to read.
account.id.step.face: Hold your ID card under your chin, front towards the camera, with the paper beside it, and take a picture of your face and both.
account.id.step.card: Then photograph the card alone, close up: the front, and the back.
account.id.step.helper: Somebody else may take the pictures for you: they are usually sharper. Look at each one before you send it. If you cannot read the number on the card, staff cannot either.
account.id.shot.face: 1. You, holding the card and the paper
account.id.shot.faceHint: Your face, the card under your chin, your reference beside it
account.id.shot.frontHint: Close up, flat, no glare. Every line readable
account.id.shot.failed: That did not go through. Tap to take it again
account.id.shot.retake: Taken. Tap to take it again
account.id.privacy: Only the two members of staff who decide see these pictures. They are deleted 30 days after the decision. The other person never sees them.
account.id.sendCta: Send the three photographs to staff
account.id.withdraw: I do not want to dispute this any more: withdraw it
account.id.contest: If you do not accept this, you can make an appointment to come in with your card, until {date}.
account.id.held: Your {what} is held: you finish what you have in hand and start nothing new until the number of your own ID card is on record.
account.id.retake: Staff could not use the photographs you sent: “{reason}”
account.id.final: This was decided in person and is final.
account.id.nothingChanged: Nothing about your registration has changed.
account.id.claimant.owedDetail: Nothing has gone to staff yet, and the other person has not been told. Send them by {date}, or this ends.
account.id.claimant.sentDetail: The person who holds the number has been told and has a week to answer. Then two members of staff decide. Come back here with your reference to see what became of it.
account.id.holder.maySend: Staff asked them for their photographs again. You can still send yours, until {date}.
account.id.holder.asked: Somebody says the national ID on your {what} is theirs
account.id.holder.askedDetail: They have sent staff photographs of themselves holding their ID card. By {date}: show your own card the same way, below. Or, if the number on your record was mistyped, put the right one there, which ends this at once. If you do nothing, the ID goes to them and your registration is held.
account.id.holder.late: Your week to answer is over, and staff may decide at any moment. You can still send your photographs until they do.
